query: Which moment-propagation approximations (delta-method vs 1–3 local MC samples) produce acceptable calibration error at boundaries, and how to set analytic vs MC fallbacks automatically during training?

response.query: Which moment-propagation approximations (delta-method vs 1–3 local MC samples) produce acceptable calibration error at boundaries, and how to set analytic vs MC fallbacks automatically during training?
response.answer: Delta-method approximations often produce acceptable calibration error at boundaries compared to 1-3 local Monte Carlo samples. Automatic fallback to analytic or MC methods during training can be set based on error thresholds and computational cost.
